column3: ore_gold@-|cutout|Gold ore marks only, BOLD: 5 or 6 chunky clusters of raw gold nuggets 4-7 px across, scattered over the square, warm gold (#9a6a18 #c8901c #eebc34 #ffe57a) with a lemon-white glint on the upper left of each nugget and a dark orange-brown outline (#5a3a10), lit from the top left, together covering about 40% of the square, not touching the edges; everything else flat solid magenta. Must read clearly as gold against grey-green stone from far away
column4: ore_gold_b@-|cutout|Gold ore marks only, BOLD, option B: 3 or 4 larger irregular veins of gold 6-10 px long branching through the square, warm gold (#9a6a18 #c8901c #eebc34 #ffe57a) with lemon-white glints and a dark orange-brown outline (#5a3a10), lit from the top left, together covering about 35% of the square, not touching the edges; everything else flat solid magenta
